plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-046 – Add Columns absent on saved draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Apply the setting under test so vendor addition is not locked during event creation.
Apply the case's required additional-stage configuration.
Give the draft a title so it can be saved and reopened from the Drafts list.
Configure the draft as an eRFX RFQ project rather than the default auction stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before applying its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is configured.
Add a line item so the draft has a valid pricing sheet.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft is in a usable saved state.
Add the minimum participant required for a complete draft setup.
Save the configured eRFX project as a draft.
Confirm the draft save completed without an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Confirm the newly saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Open this plan's saved draft from the Drafts list; drafts reopen on the create screen.
Assert the Add Columns control is not offered on the reopened draft when lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.
